en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard-style photograph of a rocky seaside cape with low cliffs descending into a calm sea. In the foreground on the right, several people in 19th‑century clothing sit or stand on the grassy, rocky shore. Across the water, a long headland forms the background. The photo is printed within an ornate decorative border with floral corners and a coat of arms at the top and bottom, and has captions in Cyrillic and French beneath the image.
